examples.title: Toggle setting
examples.description: Binary operational setting with description and save affordance.
examples.behavior: Use when a setting can change independently inside a larger form.
examples.qa: Label, description, toggle and status form one readable row.

examples.title: Saved setting
examples.description: Setting shows successful persistence after a change.
examples.behavior: Status confirms persistence without adding a separate toast for every row.
examples.qa: Saved status is subtle and does not look like a new required action.

examples.title: Setting error
examples.description: Row-level error when a setting cannot be persisted.
examples.behavior: Keep failed setting local and offer reset/retry near the control.
examples.qa: Error status names the affected row.

examples.title: Disabled setting
examples.description: Setting unavailable due to policy or inherited workspace rule.
examples.behavior: Disable mutation controls while keeping policy context readable.
examples.qa: Disabled state does not hide current setting value.

mobile.qa: Control stacks below copy without overlap.
